steps.what: Evaluate scripts, budgets, research and locations to establish the set design direction
Develop visual set design alternatives from the checked concept brief

loop.purpose: Draft visual set alternatives for exploration
loop.input: Checked concept brief and permitted references
loop.output: Concept images with intended mood, constraints and unresolved feasibility issues
loop.check: Designer checks narrative intent, location consistency, implied scale and impossible construction; concepts are redrawn where misleading
loop.stop: One small batch and correction; unsuitable alternatives return to manual sketching
loop.why_not_simpler: Visual concept interpretation is creative work rather than fixed template filling

steps.what: Refine set designs against location, budget and production requirements

tasks.design: Keep script, budget and location evaluation human in {DOCS}, then optionally draft visual alternatives in {OTHER}, an image-design tool. The designer checks meaning and feasibility before refining the proposal; images provide no construction geometry.
tasks.previous_blocker: Exploratory alternatives take drawing time before a director can compare directions.
tasks.enabler_now: Image tools can generate visual starting points from a bounded brief.
tasks.still_hard: A persuasive image may imply impossible space or construction.
tasks.human_edge: Connecting the story, real location and production constraints.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less exploratory image work; creative and feasibility decisions remain human.

reach.task: Compare visual concepts against the production's intent

evidence.claim: Adobe Creative Studio generates and edits images with Content Credentials; that capability does not produce validated set geometry.
The concept-draft saving is an unmeasured local scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is set concept development through a proposal, excluding working drawings, engineering, construction and director approval time.

Designer in s1 reads sources and captures script/version, scenes, mood, budget envelope, location constraints and permitted reference files. Capture and interpretation retain 40 hours; missing location facts are obtained manually or marked unresolved.
OTHER is an image-design tool; test native features first. No free accurate geometry, priced bill of materials or buildability flag is assumed.
Director feedback is obtained during s3, not supplied before concept generation. Script-reading work overlapping another task is assigned once in roll-up.
unknowns: Rights and access to production references
research_questions: Do image drafts save time after spatial corrections and director review?

already_counted.description: Brief capture, visual verification and design refinement

incremental.description: Maintain reference permissions and concept constraints

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=40+30*0.70+30=91, gross=9, focal upkeep=6, net=3. Range 0-1 assumes useful early visual alternatives; extensive redraws remove the gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare rough and scale set drawings

steps.what: Prepare rough drafts and develop dimensioned set geometry and construction drawing content
Prepare scale working drawings and floor plans from the checked model
Check drawing scale, dimensions, scenery and property details before handing off the proposal

tasks.design: Test native sheet and view generation in {OTHER}, a drafting system, after the designer creates and checks the dimensioned model. Generate repeated scale views and sheets, then retain human drawing review before handoff through {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated view layout and sheet formatting can sit alongside original drawing decisions.
tasks.enabler_now: Drafting systems can generate views from explicitly authored geometry and sheet rules.
tasks.still_hard: Construction intent and missing details cannot be inferred from an attractive concept image.
tasks.human_edge: Deciding what geometry, dimensions and details builders actually need.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated view production where manual; spatial and construction decisions remain human.

reach.task: Review clarity of construction drawing information

evidence.claim: Native drafting-system view and sheet generation is a plausible deterministic design, with unmeasured local savings.

assumptions: Boundary is designer drawing preparation and checking, excluding measurement work by others, engineering acceptance and physical construction.

Designer in s1 captures geometry, units, origin, dimensions, object labels, drawing/model version, views, scales, sheet sizes and detail references. Model authoring and sheet-rule capture retain 60 hours; missing measurements are clarified manually before sheet generation.
The generator consumes this authored model, not free geometry extracted from a sketch. Unsupported views or missing details are drawn manually within retained work.
Native CAD functions are tested first; existing automatic view generation earns no saving. OTHER is the drafting system.
research_questions: Does native sheet generation save manual view work after model authoring, dimension checks and upkeep?

already_counted.description: Geometry and rule capture, construction decisions and final drawing review

incremental.description: Maintain sheet definitions and view checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=60+0+15=75, gross=25, focal upkeep=8, net=17. Range 0-4 assumes repeated manual view/sheet creation; existing native generation or predominantly bespoke detailing removes the gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare exhibit renderings and technical specifications

steps.what: Develop exhibit construction, layout and material specifications and special effects or lighting diagrams
Check preliminary renderings and diagrams for consistency with the intended exhibit

tasks.design: Keep technical and spatial authorship in {OTHER}, the exhibit modelling and rendering system, with the proposal in {DOCS}. Test existing native rendering and specification tools first; their runtime is already part of normal software use and supplies no new labour saving here.
tasks.previous_blocker: Renderings and diagrams depend on unresolved design and technical choices.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing modelling tools assist presentation but do not supply validated construction details.
tasks.still_hard: Coordinating materials, lighting and effects with the actual layout.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising whether a visually coherent proposal is technically credible.
tasks.altitude: Technical design authorship and checking remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Clear technical diagrams and cross-discipline coordination

evidence.claim: Adobe Creative Studio can generate images, but that capability does not establish validated exhibit construction, layout or lighting specifications.

assumptions: Boundary is preliminary exhibit proposal authorship and checking; engineering design, detailed set working drawings and physical construction are excluded and assigned separately.
Designer interprets site facts and authors geometry, materials and diagrams during s1. No new machine step assumes a free verified model, lighting design or construction specification.
OTHER is exhibit modelling and rendering software. Existing native tools are checked first; current render runtime is not human effort.
No new tool or capture requirement means zero incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Is any repeated formatting work distinct from technical design authorship actually present?

already_counted.description: Technical design authorship and proposal checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Existing rendering runtime and unobserved formatting work create no new saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Read scripts to determine design requirements

steps.what: Read scripts to determine location, set and design requirements in narrative context

tasks.design: Keep script reading and interpretation with the designer using the current version in {DOCS}. Test native scene navigation first if retrieval is separately burdensome; a shorter synopsis does not establish equivalent understanding of set requirements.
tasks.previous_blocker: Requirements may be implicit in action, tone and relationships between scenes.
tasks.enabler_now: Document navigation supports reading without replacing interpretation.
tasks.still_hard: Identifying unstated spatial needs and resolving ambiguous narrative cues.
tasks.human_edge: Understanding the story and asking the director the right design question.

reach.task: Clarify ambiguous spatial implications of a scene

evidence.claim: Creative script reading remains interpretive work; no separate repeated breakdown-entry baseline is established.

assumptions: Boundary covers script interpretation and requirements questions, excluding set concept creation and subsequent drawings. Script reading overlapping concept evaluation is assigned once in roll-up.
Production supplies the current script/version before s1; designer derives requirements while reading. No machine assumes a free structured scene or location breakdown.
Native scene navigation is checked first if a separate retrieval burden is observed.
No new application or capture requirement means zero incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Is there repeated breakdown entry distinct from reading and narrative interpretation?

already_counted.description: Script reading and contextual requirements interpretation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Narrative understanding retains its time and concept-design reading is not counted twice.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retains narrative and spatial judgement while testing concept drafts and repeated drawing-sheet generation.
reach: Discuss feasibility, visual intent and technical questions with directors and lighting colleagues
role.ambitious_version: A designer who spends more attention on coherent, buildable spaces grounded in the production's story.
